claims: Chuck Norris was born Carlos Ray Norris in 1940.
Chuck Norris was born in Ryan, Oklahoma, on March 10, 1940.
Chuck Norris died in March 2026.
Chuck Norris was an American martial artist, actor, and producer.
Chuck Norris was a six-time undefeated world karate champion.
Chuck Norris had a role in "Walker, Texas Ranger" (1993–2001).
Chuck Norris launched his acting career against Bruce Lee in "The Way of the Dragon" (1972).
Chuck Norris began training in South Korea while in the Air Force.
Chuck Norris won the World Professional Middleweight Karate Championship in 1968.
Chuck Norris holds an eighth-degree black belt in Tae Kwon Do.
Chuck Norris founded his own style, Chun Kuk Do.
Chuck Norris starred in Missing in Action.
Chuck Norris starred in The Delta Force.
Chuck Norris starred in Code of Silence.
Chuck Norris was 86 at the time of his death.
Chuck Norris was married to Dianne Holechek.
Chuck Norris and Dianne Holechek had two children, Mike and Eric.
Chuck Norris was married to Gena O'Kelley.
Chuck Norris and Gena O'Kelley had twins, Dakota and Danilee.
Reports indicate Chuck Norris passed away on March 20, 2026, surrounded by his family.
